    [fix][bm1684x2] fix bugs
    - enable tpu_bdc_fp_avg_pool2d_ex; stage bf16/fp16 SUM/MEAN (reduce
      onedim/hw, global avg pooling) through fp32 partials so long rows
      no longer saturate the 16-bit accumulator
    - attention: allocate and load keys when M_q != M_k nc-split
    - mean_std_scale: cap slice to one bank per NPU slot; overflowing
      loads spilled into the out slot and raced the requant TIU write
    - requant_int: use INT8 shift operand for the arithmetic-shift atomic

=== bm1684x ===
commit 99fb6f9d2c6c920724782950ac71a95289ae5d33
Author: junliang.liu <junliang.liu@sophgo.com>
Date:   Mon Sep 28 14:01:22 2026 +0800

    [fix][sg2262][hau] LMEM round-robin for c>NPU_NUM
    
    HAU opd0_c > NPU_NUM channels were addressed as one full LMEM lane
    per channel (c * LOCAL_MEM_SIZE), which cannot represent more
    channels than there are NPU lanes.  Spec 2.1.2 lays them out
    round-robin instead: lane = c % NPU_NUM, and each full lap advances
    the in-lane offset by one row.
    
    Address both ends with the same formula:
    - cmodel: lmem_lane_addr() plus an assertion that one lap of rows
      still fits a single lane.  dump_hau_tensor_range() now dumps once
      per lane over rounds * lane_bytes; dumping per channel re-emitted
      the same lane run piecemeal.
    - tv_gen: scatter and clear the same round-robin layout, and extend
      the random dim_c range up to NPU_NUM.  Merge keeps opd0/opd1 in
      disjoint lap sets, so its opd1 offset becomes a fixed NPU_NUM/2
      lanes instead of dim_c lanes.
    
    For c <= NPU_NUM the formula degenerates to the old one, so existing
    single-lap cases are unchanged.
    
    Change-Id: If039fefe0c0986700d1c04c9ca2290206bc4911a
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
=== bm1688 ===
commit 8b3b71d490f1cf037ddf3c8212f07c1bf5cdef9f
Author: yujia liu <yujia.liu@sophgo.com>
Date:   Thu Oct 8 11:24:06 2026 +0800

    fix(bm1688): size softmax max_lo/max_buf by h_total
    
    - nodechip_softmax_local_1x1() sized both buffers for a single aligned
      float, but the reduction stores one slot per h-slice
    - with c_per_npu == 1 anything needing more than four slices overran into
      exp_imm0_lo / exp_imm1_lo
    - size them by max(one aligned float, h_total floats)
    
    Change-Id: I485e0eab2937a7b9ee03274390fc95d508f7fe42
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>
